subject: prd/feature-draft
statement: Measure proposals per draft (M1) at the checkpoint after the first three draft-born features, and iterate the process on a miss.
intent: Record the approved mitigation for this exact requirement-ledger risk.
rationale: One proposal per draft is the draft's main promise (G1) and is still an assumption when a draft spans many sessions and rounds. Measuring it keeps the claim honest, and a miss changes the process instead of the target.
fit_criterion: At the checkpoint, M1 reports the proposals from opening to lock for each of the first three draft-born features, and any feature above one proposal has a recorded process change.
